title: Metal Black
overview:
Staking everything on the restoration of peace

That ultimate weapon was sealed away in darkness when the world chose a peace called compromise. But as this planet was dying out, it broke free of the darkness and rose again. As the ultimate weapon......

Metal Black is a horizontal shooter, a conversion of the Taito arcade game. Earth has made a lopsided peace with alien invaders and is slowly dying, so a lone soldier steals the Black Fly, a fighter built around the mysterious Newalone energy, and takes the battle from Earth out into space. There are no weapon pickups or bombs: gather the floating red, blue and yellow Newalone molecules to strengthen your shot and fill your beam meter, then unleash a huge beam that tears through enemies and terrain. Bosses feed on Newalone too, and when your beam meets theirs the two collide in a beam duel won by the stronger side.

- 6 rounds plus 2 bonus stages with 3D lock-on missile shooting
- 1 or 2 players simultaneously, with a second player able to join at any time
- Four difficulty levels and adjustable starting lives
- Memory backup save

平和への復権をかけて

その最終兵器は、妥協という名の平和を選んだ時、闇に封印された。しかしこの惑星が死に絶えるとき、闇を解き放ち再び甦った。最終兵器として……
